title: Daily Market Briefing
text:
BOTTOM LINE — Risk-off, metals and small caps led down.
Precious-metal miners and small caps were sold hardest (SILJ -5.44%, GDX -4.36%, IWM -1.84%) while oil +3.30% and the dollar +0.60% squeezed the inflation-sensitive trade — only 34% of S&P 500 names advanced and just 46% sit above the 200-DMA. With hike odds rising and 10-year yields up (IEF -1.06%), this was a rate-shock de-risking day, not a dip-buy.

INDICES — VIX 14.2, below its 20-day MA of 15.6.
SOXX -1.23%, SPY -0.72%, QQQ -0.84%, DIA -0.71%, IWM -1.84%; large beat small by 0.40pp. Biggest cross-asset move: USO +3.30%, with the dollar +0.60%. Neither SPY nor QQQ is below its 200-DMA.

VOLUME & BREADTH — SPY traded 1.3x average, QQQ lighter; SOXX 1.4x and IJH 1.4x gained attention while GLD 0.7x and IJR 0.8x were ignored. Volume up with price down in SPY and SOXX signals distribution. Breadth diverges hard from the flat index tape: 28% above the 50-DMA, 46% above the 200-DMA, adv/dec 168/332, up/down volume 0.42, and 105 new 60-day lows against 13 highs.

SECTORS & ROTATION — XLI Industrials +0.07%, XLE Energy +0.00%, XLP Staples -0.36%, XLK Technology -0.47%, XLF Financials -0.47%, XLB Materials -0.49%, XLV Healthcare -0.64%, XLY Discretionary -1.50%, XLRE Real Estate -1.55%, XLC Comms -1.91%, XLU Utilities -1.92%. Top industries USO +3.30% and MSOS +1.88%; bottom SILJ -5.44% and GDX -4.36%. Flows confirm the defensive bid: XLY +$711mm (100th pctile) and XLK +$147mm in; XLF -$2,305mm and XLV -$1,089mm out — but XLE bled -$890mm despite flat price. Money is leaving financials, healthcare and energy; it is not going anywhere — DIA +$1,971mm in while SPY -$13,002mm out. Rangebound chop.

POSITIONING — SPY PCR 1.13 and QQQ PCR 1.27 show real protection demand; QQQ skew +6.2% puts a fat premium on downside. SPY ATM IV 9.8% against a VIXEQ of 39.2 versus VIX 14.2 is an extreme dispersion gap — a stock-picker's tape with very low implied correlation. No MOVE or gamma-flip print available.

CROSS-ASSET — WTI +3.30% with the dollar +0.60% crushed gold -1.80% and silver -4.23%, and 20-year Treasuries -1.58% confirm the yield-driven read. Next FOMC: Oct 28, 2026; CME FedWatch shows a 100.0% hike, and Polymarket prices 64% for a 25bp hike (up 10pp in five days) versus 34% for no change.

SIGNALS & WATCH — Fear & Greed 53, Neutral. Top movers: PANW +5.00%, WPM -5.44%, PAAS -5.39% (both no catalyst in feed). Vol spikes: UNG 2.8x on +0.09% and FNGS 2.2x on +0.02% — benign, no accumulation signal. Momentum extremes: XLK leads 20-day at +7.48%, XLU lags at -8.22%; SOXX's +12.68% five-day is the standout. Watch SLV (-4.23%, 31.3% ATM IV), USO (+3.30% five-day +17.98% break) and IWM (PCR 0.22, 105 new lows) tomorrow.
